scope: Pixelmon PC contents not updating on the client after login: the report, what the server's files showed, the cause as traced in bytecode, the fix and how far it was checked. No game client was started.
report: Party full; a caught Pokemon is announced as sent to the PC
The PC screen does not show it
A party Pokemon put into the PC then shows in both places

server_files_read_only.when: 2026-11-14 about 09:00 UTC, world created about six hours earlier by the owner

sequence: PixelmonStorageManager.onPlayerLogin (PlayerLoggedInEvent, priority HIGHEST) sends ClientInitializePCPacket and one ClientSetPacket per occupied PC slot as soon as the PC is loaded
On the client ServerConfigListPacket.handlePacket calls ClientStorageManager.load(), which replaces the map of known PCs with an empty one and leaves the PC object the screen draws untouched
ClientSetPacket.handlePacket finds no PC for the UUID, logs 'No storage on the client side with UUID' and drops the change; opening the PC sends no contents

A party Pokemon dropped on the slot that looks empty is moved in the client's own cache first; the server rejects the swap because the slot is occupied and resends both positions; the party position is applied, the PC position is dropped
cause.order_depends_on: Whether the PC file finished loading before the tracker's handler; it differs from login to login and its frequency on the live server is not known
cause.real_duplicate_on_the_server: Not by this path: ServerSwapPacket and ServerTrashPacket check the UUID in the slot before changing anything. Other PC-changing packets were not traced
cause.this_projects_patches_and_other_mods: None touches Pixelmon's channel, its storage classes or ClientSetPacket (mixin configurations and class constant pools of every JAR in the client pack and the server profile searched)
cause.how_established: Three investigators (Pixelmon code path, this project's patches and other mods, public reports) and a fourth who re-read the decisive methods and found the call the first explanation missed: ServerConfigListPacket emptying the PC map
cause.upstream: No changelog line for this was found for Pixelmon 9.2.4 to 9.2.6 (web search summaries, not checked against the original pages)

fix.what: At the end of PixelmonPlayerTracker.onPlayerLogin the player's PC is sent again through Pixelmon's own StorageProxy.initializePCForPlayer, on the server thread. Any exception is logged as a warning and the login continues. Each resend writes one debug line

build.scope: Only the authored PC resend class, its mixin configuration and manifest/provenance. Port, Pixelmon and upstream code and assets and the earlier authored corrections are preserved.

checks.what_pc_resend_shows: Pixelmon's login handler, run for a server-side stand-in player without posting the login event, finished without an exception, and the new class logged that it sent that player's PC again
checks.what_it_does_not_show: That a real client receives the second PC and that the report's symptoms are gone

not_verified: No real client login with the new common JAR, and no v20 client (previous common JAR) connecting to a server with the new one
The bug was not reproduced in game, before or after the fix
Whether the affected players' client logs contain 'No storage on the client side with UUID'
The same order problem in a single-player world of the pack
found_and_left: ServerSwapPacket's reject branch resends the second position from the first storage (storage1.get(position2))
PartyStorage.get accepts an index equal to the party length
